notes.title: Hotfix #2 Further Fixes and Balancing
notes.content:
We're back again with some more fixes and new content. Including improved matchmaking, improved performance and [b]two brand new weapons![/b]


[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Performance & stability[/h3]

-	Further crash fixes
-	Improved performance in decal & lights positioning systems
-	Improved performance of animation systems 
-	Improved performance of (de)materialization effects system
-	Improved game startup loading times by about 20% on lower end machines
-	Fixed two performance issues where you could get major lag (spikes)

We are constantly working on improving performance by tweaking small changes like seen above, and will try to further improve the performance step by step rest assured.

[h3] Matchmaking[/h3]

 -	Improved matchmaking flow to better handle back-filling and team distribution

Keep in mind that with low player population it might still be hard to find a game. Because of this for the meantime we have set the matchmaking open to all, so you can also be queued into matches on other regions.

[h3]Animation[/h3]

-	Fixed an issue where the animation rig wasn’t swapped when gender of selected character skin
        was changed causing incorrect proportions in animation.
-	Fixed an issue where melee and reload animations wouldn’t play on high latency.
-	Fixed an issue where the reload animations could play faster than expected.
-	Fixed third person hit flinching not working on characters when damaged.
-	Fixed an issue where weapon sway would be applied after landing a vault
-	Improved all aiming animations slightly
-	Improved sprint to slide transition

[h3]Audio[/h3]

-	Added audio to various UI elements (button hovers and clicks, slider changes, toggle changes etc)
-	Added audio to progression screen at the end of the game
-	Added intense background music to signify the nearing end of the game
-	Fixed an issue with player footsteps not being the correct surface type

[h3]Party[/h3]

-	Fixed an issue where the party invite would fail after a crash or alt+f4’ing the game

[h3]Visuals[/h3]

-	Reflex sight visibility & clarity improved

[h3]Settings menu[/h3]

-	Fixed an issue where pressing “esc” during the rebinding process closed the whole settings menu
-	Fixed an issue where the resolution was unreasonably small on first startup

[h3]Wardrobe[/h3]

-	Fixed an issue where the character skin list would snap to a random location when initialized
-	Fixed an issue where you could equip a weapon with the “change skin” input


[h3]Quick Access Bar[/h3]

-	Increased the scroll sensitivity on the quick access bar (e.g. friends list)

[h3]Skin Shop
[/h3]
-	Fixed an issue where you could get stuck when pressing esc immediately after buying a skin

[h3]Currency Shop[/h3]

-	Fixed an issue where pricing was showing the incorrect currency symbol while the price was localized
-	Fixed an issue where ended transactions would still show a dark screen over the game


[h2]TWO NEW WEAPONS[/h2]

[h3]The Windsong[/h3]

Crafted from sacred hazel wood and tipped with razor-sharp obsidian, the Windsong is a very versatile weapon. Light and precise, it can get Contenders out of any close combat situation or hit enemies from afar with a single, precise throw, piercing armor and inflicting grievous wounds. In the hands of a skilled warrior the Windsong will tip the scales of battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378175/26f8857526927eb3d1c7c62bab36d64930d17af1.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Matchstick[/h3]

Ignite the battlefield with The Matchstick, ΣRA's latest incendiary weapon, an advanced firearm designed to deliver maximum impact. Charge the weapon to unleash a devastating torrent of incendiary pellets, engulfing your enemies in flames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378175/4b235f755ce7712e792262f2ad347cacb98c54b4.jpg[/img]

Thank you for feedback and see you again soon!

The StickyLock Team

notes.title: Hotfix #1 - Initial Fixes and Balancing
notes.content:
Thank you for joining us for the release of Histera! The first hotfix has just been released and includes fixes and weapon balancing changes based on your initial feedback.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Crash fix[/h3]

We’ve applied a fix for one of the more prominent crashes relating to the glitch during gameplay.

[h3]HE Grenade[/h3]

The HE Grenade is now correctly thrown instead of dropped directly at your feet.

[h3]Profile Progression[/h3]

Tiers have been reset and adjusted to reflect the difficulty of the progression steps.

[h3]Performance & Stability[/h3]

Our current focus lies on stability fixes and performance improvements, the latter of which will be rolled out in small steps over the coming weeks. At the same time we are experimenting with smaller changes that might yield improvements to stability even more quickly. We'll keep you updated! 


[h2]Weapon Changes[/h2]

We've made several balance changes based on your initial reception and feedback. Let us know how the weapons feel after these changes!

[h3]Hunting Bow[/h3]
[list]
[*]Headshot damage multiplier adjusted from 1.5 to 1.7
[*]Projectile size reduced from 0.3 to 0.275
[*]Charge damage multiplier adjusted from 3 to 2
[*]Removed unintended slow
[/list]
[h3]Karabiner 43[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced screenshake intensity
[*]Reduced ADS sway
[*]Reduced recoil buildup
[/list]
[h3]AR-77[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced ADS sway
[*]Adjusted ADS sway radius
[*]Aim punch speed increased
[*]Damage decreased from 18 to 16
[*]Accuracy adjusted
[*]Bullet spread toned down
[/list]
[h3]Cyclone S6[/h3]
[list]
[*]Damage decreased from 12 to 11
[*]Hipfire accuracy improved
[*]Accuracy adjusted
[*]Bullet spread toned down
[/list]
[h3]Stormbringer T-2000[/h3]
[list]
[*]Base damage increased from 20 to 40
[*]Charge damage multiplier reduced from 6 to 2.5
[*]Electricity status effect removed
[/list]

Thank you for feedback and see you again soon!

The StickyLock Team

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo - Upcoming Fixes and Known Issues
notes.content:
[h1]Upcoming Fixes and Known Issues [/h1]

We’re hard at work on new builds aimed at enhancing your gaming experience. Here’s a peek at what you can expect in this updated.

[h2]Stability Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved a crash when accessing settings while in-game.
[*] Fixed the user configuration issue causing start-up troubles.
[*] Improved in-game loading screen for faster loading speed, complete with a captivating moving animation to assure you it’s not stuck.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the spawning issue where players kept spawning in the same map section.
[*] Tweaked certain weapons for better game balance (apologies to spear enthusiasts, but it was a bit too strong).
[*] Added a movement grace period to invulnerability. Direct movement won’t cancel invulnerability for a short time after spawning.
[*] Grenades no longer pass-through collision.
[/list]

[h2]Weapon Balancing[/h2]

[h3]AR-77[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased ammo capacity from 25 to 30.
[*] Reduced mid-range damage reduction from 20% to 10%.
[*] Reduced long-range damage reduction from 35% to 20%.
[*] Increased limb damage multiplier from 0.8x to 1.0x.
[*] Improved armor penetration from 75% to 80%.
[*] Reduced rounds fired per second from 12 to 7.
[*] Extended close-range from 30m to 40m.
[/list]

[h3]Rockstorm[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased projectile hit radius from 0.3 to 0.4.
[/list]

[h3]Hunting Spear[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted maximum charge damage multiplier from 4x to 2.5x.
[/list]

[h3]Hunting Bow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly lowered armor penetration from 100% to 90%.
[*] Increased charge duration from 0.5s to 0.825s.
[/list]

[h3]Poison Puffer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased projectile hit radius from 0.2 to 0.3.
[/list]

[h3]Obsidian Darts[/h3]
[list]
[*] Boosted velocity from 80 to 120.
[*] Increased projectile hit radius from 0.2 to 0.4.
[/list]

[h2]Settings Streamlining[/h2]
[list]
[*] Corrected key bindings that were mistakenly linked to each other (forward and backwards).
[/list]
[h2] Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hidden the progression bar, as it’s not fully functional in the demo. Our apologies to those who lost EXP after winning.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
We’re actively investigating the following ongoing issues:
[list]
[*] Queueing difficulties.
[*] Party-related problems.
[*] Performance and additional stability concerns.
[/list]
Please be aware that it may not be possible to resolve all of these known issues within the demo’s time frame, but your feedback is invaluable in identifying and addressing them more swiftly. You can report issues through the in-game bug report tool (accessed from the pause menu by pressing the "ESC key") or via our Discord channel #demo-feedback.

Thank you for your support, understanding, and your ongoing dedication to making Histera the best it can be. We’ll keep you updated as these fixes progress!

-	StickyLock Games
